description: The Enterprise emerges from the Gorn crisis into a run of increasingly unusual missions that challenge the crew's identities, relationships and understanding of what Starfleet is becoming.

s03e01.description: Pike and the Enterprise fight to recover their captured crewmates as the Gorn confrontation begun at Parnassus Beta reaches its conclusion.

s03e02.description: A seemingly joyous wedding celebration begins bending reality around the Enterprise crew and exposes unresolved feelings beneath the festivities.

s03e03.description: A shuttle mission to Kenfori strands crew members in dangerous territory where the local situation is far stranger than their briefing suggested.

s03e04.description: The crew becomes caught inside a stylized adventure scenario whose familiar genre rules conceal a real threat to the Enterprise.

s03e05.description: An archaeological discovery forces the crew to examine evidence through multiple perspectives as ancient technology begins affecting the present.

s03e06.description: A mission involving a damaged vessel and an unexpected young survivor pushes the crew into a chase whose stakes grow far beyond the original rescue.

s03e07.description: An outside observer examines life aboard the Enterprise and asks what Starfleet actually represents when its ideals collide with practical decisions.

s03e08.description: A transporter-related experiment leaves several crew members experiencing Vulcan traits, turning a scientific procedure into a test of identity and relationships.

s03e09.description: A mysterious environment isolates members of the crew and forces them to understand an unfamiliar life-form before containment becomes catastrophe.

s03e10.description: The Enterprise confronts a discovery with implications for new life and civilization, bringing the season's personal and exploratory threads together.
